comparison.objective: Carry a three-box stack to a shelf as one intact stack.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual squeezing, load stabilization, transport, and shelf placement.
comparison.success_condition: Stack never separates beyond limits and ends level, aligned, and supported on the shelf.
comparison.reason: The candidate does not test transport of an unstable stack; it tests retained rotary adjustment and dynamic damping performance.
